title: Renew a security operative licence
summary: You can renew your security operative licence online for a period of 1 or 5 years.
intro:
You can renew your security operative licence for 1 or 5 years. This can be done online:

### If your licence has expired

If it's more than 90 days after the expiry date on your licence, you need to apply for a new licence.

When your licence has expired, you cannot carry on security activities. You can resume security activities only after your late licence renewal application is granted.

After renewal is granted, you must wear your expired security licence card until you receive your new card.
who_can_apply: Your licence has not expired by more than 90 days.
what_you_need: Your licence and renewal number (including all digits and letters, as shown on your renewal reminder notice)
Your name, date of birth, and postcode (if you do not have your renewal number)

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew your security operative licence.

faqs.q: What happens if my licence has expired?
faqs.a: If your licence expired more than 90 days ago, you must apply for a new licence. You cannot carry out security activities until your late renewal application is granted.

faqs.q: How long must I wear my licence card after renewal?
faqs.a: After renewal is granted, you must wear your expired security licence card until you receive your new card.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to renew their security operative licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence if it has not expired by more than 90 days.
